additions.title: UX32-A1 the counter keeps price duration and finite authorization while full trade forecasts are optional readonly details
UX32-A2 every protected sale has one clear gate without a fake price zero trade or changed save
UX32-A3 actual purchase and sale gates remain clear and a six second trip never performs an unconfirmed trade
UX32-A4 paused original trade keeps cumulative limits and complete progress without treating a later draft as saved
UX32-A5 START failure preserves the complete old intent while all optional viewing stays readonly
UX32-A5 TICK failure preserves the complete old intent while all optional viewing stays readonly
